about_the_game:
An all-new maid type, the "Tsundere -Prideful and Competitive-" (A.K.A. Tsundere) is making her appearance in Custom Order Maid 3D2! 

This DLC lets you hire a "Tsundere" maid at your Empire Club just as you would a "Muku," "Majime," or "Rindere" maid.

~Just who is this Tsundere -Prideful and competitive-?～

She's a girl with a lot of self-confidence who always speaks her mind. She has a tendency toward black-and-white thinking: what she dislikes, she despises, and what she likes, she adores. Because of her honesty, other people's opinions on her are divided.

• You can enjoy watching your Tsundere maid train, talk to others at her job, and work at the Empire Club!

• Playable events are available before becoming a lover with Tsundere, such as a love story and scenes where she interacts with other maids!

Please be advised that this DLC may contain BDSM or BDSM-adjacent content.

-CAUTION-

If you're playing COM3D2 It's a Night Magic without the R-18 patch, you will need update ver. 1.26 to play the "Tsundere ~Prideful and Competitive~" DLC.

Otherwise, Tsundere WILL NOT show up in COM3D2 It's a Night Magic.

Please visit our website and install the update manually.

-Install Instructions-

1. Download update from our website

(It may take awhile to download)

2. Extract the zip folder, and double click the "update.exe" file.
